## Description

Per-language evaluation sets, ongoing clinician trust metrics, red-team prompt-injection tests against uploaded documents and transcripts, overlap/speaker suites for multi-speaker clip recordings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** CI runs per-language and red-team suites on every prompt/model change.
- [ ] **AC2.** Overlap and speaker-attribution suites pass for clip recordings (exit gate 1).
- [ ] **AC3.** Trust metrics are reported monthly per clinician cohort.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
